literal_meaning: হাসি ধরে না (smile does not hold/stick)
figurative_meaning_en: A broad smile spreading across the entire face
similar_in_english: Can't wipe the smile off one's face
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুব খুশি হয়ে উঠেছে, মুখে হাসি ধরে না।
বন্ধুর সাফল্য দেখে তার হাসি ধরে না।
example_sentences_in_english: She is so happy that a smile spreads across her entire face.
Seeing his friend's success, he couldn't stop beaming.
note: This idiom vividly captures the uncontrollable joy in Bengali culture, often used in informal settings to describe overwhelming happiness.
